concepts.name: 余烬·倾岳
concepts.design: A red and coral eccentric anvil warhammer. The head is a very large asymmetrical horizontal solid angular block, with a MASSIVE broad bevelled rectangular striking face on the LEFT, tapering through two offset architectural steps into a shorter compact rectangular counterweight on the RIGHT. The head's center of mass is visibly offset left of the long shaft. A robust forked angular yoke supports the head from below with ONE triangular negative space underneath the anvil, no detached structural parts. Keep striking face flat, thick and blunt, no pointed axe blades. Dark crimson large faces, bright thin coral chamfers and red energy seams. Long straight thick red shaft with two plain octagonal grip zones, compact rectangular pommel. A few red triangular ember chips escaping from the large left striking face, subtle glow. Design expresses brutal weight and deliberate imbalance, clean sculptural silhouette.

concepts.name: 流萤·森垒
concepts.design: An emerald and mint woven-cage warhammer. The head is a short fat horizontal rectangular cage: two MASSIVE blunt square striking end caps connected by THREE thick curved geometric arch bands interweaving above and below, forming clear large hollow windows through the central hammer head. Bands are heavy load-bearing beams, not thin wires or vines. The head silhouette bulges softly in its center like an architectural woven vault, square ends stay visible and suitable for striking. All bands securely joined into the end caps. Small mint geometric motes drift in the open cage center. Dark jade faces and pale mint luminous edge bands, no leaves or organic branches. Long substantial slightly tapered green shaft with two unobstructed straight grip zones separated by a narrow collar, faceted hexagonal pommel. The cage construction must remain readable in a three-quarter view; no giant glowing core filling the windows.

concepts.name: 寒汐·断垒
concepts.design: A deep-blue turquoise split-pillar warhammer. Head is TWO huge parallel vertical rectangular monolith blocks separated by one clean narrow VERTICAL slot, held rigidly together by a broad lower crossbeam and a short recessed upper structural bridge. Overall head is a wide squat squared U, not a spear fork: block height roughly equal to combined width, with thick wide flat outer sides serving as hammer striking faces. Left block is slightly taller than right, each has three broad bevelled terraces on top. The cyan slit is central and visible from front; sparse short horizontal cyan dash particles suspended in it. No sharp upward spikes, no blades. Head joins a long substantial blue shaft through a wide trapezoid neck. Two comfortable straight grip zones on the shaft, narrow cyan inset strips, compact stepped squared pommel. Dark petrol-blue faces, aqua bevels and restrained icy-cyan emission. Brutalist, monumental, clearly very heavy.

concepts.name: 梦隙·沉环
concepts.design: A violet orchid captive-core halo warhammer. The head is a thick architectural OCTAGONAL open ring oriented in the weapon's frontal plane, with TWO massive opposing flat rectangular striking pads at LEFT and RIGHT, so it reads as a hammer with a hollow central head, not a staff. The octagonal ring is built from thick offset interlocking angular segments, broad sides reveal substantial depth. A small solid irregular purple polyhedral energy core is cradled inside the open center by three clearly visible recessed diagonal struts, leaving generous empty space around it; core never fills the hole. Tiny lavender triangular motes orbit locally around the small core, not a giant aura. Robust double-chevron yoke supports ring from below, directly connected to a long substantial straight purple shaft with two plain hand grip zones. Angular diamond-capped pommel. Dark violet planar faces, orchid and lilac fluorescent bevels. Elegant unsettling symmetry, bold mass and crisp readable joints, no delicate ornamental filigree.
